## Verification run

- `flutter analyze` - no issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` - clean; `flutter test` - 33 passed.
- `serverpod generate` and `flutter gen-l10n` - no diff, so generated code is not stale.
- Server `dart analyze --fatal-infos` - no issues; `dart format` - clean.
- Server `dart test` against a host-network `ghcr.io/serverpod/postgres:16` on port 9090 - 65 passed, 2 skipped (`backend-pending`).
- Coverage pipeline plus `tool/coverage_gate.dart` - authorization 95.5% (21/22 lines), PASS.
- `edubox_fixtures` `dart test` - 6 passed; `dart analyze` - no issues.
- Not run: Docker image build, compose `e2e` profile, MinIO, AVD.

## Confirmed sound

- Authorization is server-side: `requireCaller` reads `users` per call (guard.dart:31-47), `requireLogin` is on, table models are `serverOnly`, no table or `storagePath` reaches `edubox_client`.
- The matrix reads the live dispatch table and fails on unlisted or stale rows; per-caller allow and deny tests exist for every EduBox method.
- `content.library` filters `approved` plus class scope; the draft, other-class and 7B items are asserted absent.
- `passwords.yaml` is git-ignored and was never committed; `passwords.example.yaml` holds only labelled dev values.
- The sign-in changes in fff25a5 do not weaken assertions: `RollbackDatabase.disabled` is needed because login opens its own transaction, and serverpod_test 4.0.4 drops the ephemeral database per group, so committed data does not leak across files; the no-self-service group still asserts `MethodNotFoundException` and unchanged auth-user, users and account-request counts.
- The ARB has all 98 keys and covers every key in the six briefs, with `signingOut` and `eduboxMarkSemantics` resolved to aliases.
